title: Algebra and area
subject: Mathematics
schemeText:
Q1 Expand and simplify 3(x + 4) - 2(x - 1). (2) M1 both brackets expanded correctly: 3x + 12 - 2x + 2. A1 x + 14.
Q2 Solve 5x - 7 = 2x + 8. (2) M1 collecting x terms and numbers correctly, e.g. 3x = 15. A1 x = 5.
Q3 A rectangle is (2x + 3) cm long and 4 cm wide. Its area is 44 cm^2. Find x. (3) M1 forming 4(2x + 3) = 44 or equivalent. M1 correct method to solve, e.g. 8x = 32 or 2x + 3 = 11. A1 x = 4.
A correct answer with no working gets full marks unless the question asks for working.

reference.notes: Q1 correct answer, no working: full marks per scheme. Q3 inverse-operations method is valid (M1 M1) but 11 - 3 = 8, so A0.

flags: Q1: correct answer with no working shown; the scheme allows full marks.
Q3: unusual but valid method (working backwards). Arithmetic slip 11 - 3 = 7.
demoResult.feedback: Working backwards from the area was a clever way to tackle Q3. Next, double-check each subtraction: 11 - 3 is 8, which would have given x = 4.
